description: Across 2026-10-11/12, oracle-verdict repeatedly reported opus/sol absent (error) (e.g. PR #2913 verdicts 00:52, 13:42, 14:37 UTC), forcing the S10 stand-in path; separately oracle-review runs failed ~10 times with 'dispatched PR identity or head changed' despite zero pushes between dispatch and job start (runs 38189396586, 38189696110, 38267710604, 38270039090, 38283247598 on PRs #2907/#2913). A manual workflow_dispatch --ref develop is rejected by the head guard by design; the feature-branch ref is the correct dispatch target. Substantive review still arrived (muse SHIP/SHIP-WITH-FIXES verdicts), so this is reliability, not coverage. The real gate error hides behind the race message: unresolved oracle review threads block with the same exit path — check threads before rerunning.
